detail.value: My card was billed A$49.00 twice for the same invoice on 3 March. The second line shows the same reference as the first.
Our account was billed A$1,240.00 twice on 11 April and the second charge has already cleared, which has taken the operating account below its float.
We have been billed for 240 seats every month since January while our signed order is for 40. Four invoices are affected and finance has frozen payment on all of them.

closing.value: Could you check the invoice and refund the extra amount when you get a chance?
This is the second time this month and I am losing patience with it.
I would like to raise a formal complaint about the billing handling and have it recorded.
